reuse.why: Adds the check inside the existing linkBankSyncAccount that every provider link goes through, reusing the account row the routine already loads.

duplication.why: The upgrading-account lookup is moved up and reused instead of being queried twice; the rule exists once.

placement.why: The guard runs in the shared link routine before the existing link assertion and any write; it is inline rather than an assert in link.ts next to assertBankAccountNotLinkedElsewhere, a minor inconsistency.

scope.why: Only linkBankSyncAccount and its tests change.

maintainability.why: One place decides whether a link target is acceptable, and the hoisted lookup makes all preconditions run before side effects.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six provider link functions call linkBankSyncAccount.

one_place.where: linkBankSyncAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, shared by all provider link handlers.
